boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the Steamboat Road, Steppingstone Lane, and Middle Neck Road corridors near Kings Point.

cards.title: Kings Point Park
cards.subtitle: Steamboat Road corridor, Kings Point
cards.notes: Enter from Steamboat Road for the trail network, then use the posted park amenities as a starting point for an outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A large park with trails and several outdoor recreation areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Neck Park District identifies a Steamboat Road entrance and more than five miles of hiking trails at Kings Point Park.
cards.source_title: Kings Point Park | Great Neck Park District
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7 a.m. to dusk; the district lists the Steamboat Road entrance and restrooms there.

cards.title: Steppingstone Park
cards.subtitle: Steppingstone Lane corridor, Kings Point
cards.notes: Use the Steppingstone Lane approach to orient yourself at the waterfront park and marina area before planning any permitted activity.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront park whose marina is a central feature.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Neck Park District identifies Steppingstone Park on Steppingstone Lane and describes its Long Island Sound setting and marina.
cards.source_title: Steppingstone Park | Great Neck Park District
cards.access_notes: Check Park District requirements and current rules before using marina, beach-boat, or boating facilities.

cards.title: Village Green & Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Walk the formal garden and pause by the Veterans' Memorial, gazebo, and bandstand; follow posted park guidance while visiting.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped public green with memorial and garden features.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Neck Park District places the Village Green & Rose Garden on Middle Neck Road and lists its rose garden, gazebo, bandstand, and Veterans' Memorial.
cards.source_title: Major Parks | Great Neck Park District
cards.access_notes: The Park District manages the site; consult its current policies before attending any programmed event.

cards.title: Great Neck House
cards.subtitle: Beside the Middle Neck Road corridor via Arrandale Avenue
cards.notes: Check the calendar for a film, performance, class, or exhibit, and use the facility's public Wi-Fi or meeting spaces during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A Park District cultural facility with event and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Great Neck Park District lists meeting rooms, public Wi-Fi, restrooms, and cultural programming resources at Great Neck House.
cards.source_title: Great Neck House | Great Neck Park District
cards.access_notes: Listed building hours are Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; registration hours may differ and some activities may require a park card.

cards.title: Krön Chocolatier
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Stop by the retail shop to browse its chocolate and gift selection, and confirm the day's hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A confectionery storefront on Middle Neck Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Krön Chocolatier identifies its retail store at 41 Middle Neck Road and describes its gourmet chocolates and personalized gifts.
cards.access_notes: The business lists retail-store hours Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m., and Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: New Fu Run
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's location page to confirm the address, then review its menu before choosing a meal or takeout plan.
cards.short_summary: A Northern Chinese cuisine restaurant on the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: New Fu Run's official location page lists its Great Neck restaurant at 50 Middle Neck Road.
cards.source_title: Location | New Fu Run Traditional Northern Chinese Cuisine
cards.access_notes: Review the restaurant's current ordering and service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Gino's of Great Neck
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Use the official site to check the menu or ordering options, then visit the Middle Neck Road location for a casual meal.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated pizzeria and restaurant on Middle Neck Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's official site states that its family-owned Great Neck restaurant is located at 60 Middle Neck Road.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service and ordering details on the business website before going.

cards.title: Rothchilds Coffee & Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Check the posted hours and menu, then plan a coffee, meal, or takeout stop around the restaurant's current operating schedule.
cards.short_summary: A coffee and kitchen destination with posted weekly hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Rothchilds' official site lists its Great Neck address as 76 Middle Neck Road and provides weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday–Friday noon–9 p.m., Saturday noon–10 p.m., Sunday 11 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Gold Coast Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Check the current classes, workshops, films, events, or exhibits, then enter through the Maple Drive parking-lot entrance specified by the center.
cards.short_summary: An arts center offering classes, films, events, and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Gold Coast Arts Center lists its location at 113 Middle Neck Road and says visitors must enter through the Maple Drive parking lot.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Gold Coast Arts Center
cards.access_notes: The center lists regular hours of Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; program access may vary.

cards.title: La Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor, Great Neck
cards.notes: Review the online menu or ordering information, then use the listed Middle Neck Road address for a straightforward meal stop.
cards.short_summary: A pizzeria with an official Great Neck location page.
cards.evidence_claim: La Pizzeria's official site lists its Great Neck location at 114 Middle Neck Road.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service hours and ordering options directly with the restaurant before visiting.
